comment: What the packaged extractor must make of each fixture in this directory. release-acceptance.py converts every *.apmap here with the archive's own extractor and compares the .map it wrote with these counts; a fixture with no entry fails the run. release-acceptance.apmap is the APMap 1.3 slab kept as backward-compatibility evidence. release-acceptance-1.5.apmap is a Quake 1 APMap 1.5 document carrying what 1.4 added (authorship, three nested groups) so that a changed version header is not the whole of the coverage. release-acceptance-q2-1.5.apmap (Q2_020) is an independently authored Quake II APMap 1.5 room, converted from source/release-acceptance-q2-1.5.map with --q2map-to-apmap by the extractor a release bundles: its `face_suffixes` are Quake II face tails (contents, flags, value) the bundled extractor must write back — a light panel (SURF_LIGHT, value 300), a detail pillar (CONTENTS_DETAIL) and a translucent window in a func_group (CONTENTS_WINDOW, SURF_TRANS33). No game data, no external corpus.
